items.title: Crypto Group Warns Regulators Against Expanding Stablecoin KYC
items.summary: The crypto trade group warned that forcing issuers to verify identities for peer-to-peer wallet transfers would “cripple the industry” as regulators implement the GENIUS Act.

items.title: Jury Convicts Las Vegas Man of $24M AI Crypto Mining Ponzi Scheme
items.summary: Brent Kovar told at least 400 investors a supercomputer was mining crypto for them, and that their money was insured by the FDIC.
